original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-localize-cartesian-square}
Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site. Let
$$
\xymatrix{
X' \ar[d] \ar[r] & X \ar[d] \\
Y' \ar[r] & Y
}
$$
be a cartesian diagram of $\mathcal{C}$. Then we have
$j_{Y'/Y}^{-1} \circ Rj_{X/Y, *} = Rj_{X'/Y', *} \circ j_{X'/X}^{-1}$
as functors $D(\mathcal{C}/X) \to D(\mathcal{C}/Y')$.

stage_a_standalone_statement_draft:
For a morphism $X\to Y$ in a site $\mathcal C$, write $j_{X/Y}:\mathrm{Sh}(\mathcal C/X)\to\mathrm{Sh}(\mathcal C/Y)$ for the localization morphism of topoi; on a ringed site it induces the corresponding morphism of ringed topoi. The restriction functors $j^{-1}$ (abelian sheaves) and $j^*$ (ringed-module sheaves) are exact. Consider a cartesian square $X'=X\times_Y Y'$ in $\mathcal C$. The cohomology statement is in derived categories of **abelian sheaves**, without assuming any ringed structure and without assuming the square is an open-immersion square.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-localize-cartesian-square-modules}
Let $(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{O})$ be a ringed site. Let
$$
\xymatrix{
X' \ar[d] \ar[r] & X \ar[d] \\
Y' \ar[r] & Y
}
$$
be a cartesian diagram of $\mathcal{C}$. Then we have
$j_{Y'/Y}^* \circ Rj_{X/Y, *} = Rj_{X'/Y', *} \circ j_{X'/X}^*$
as functors
$D(\mathcal{O}_X) \to D(\mathcal{O}_{Y'})$.

stage_a_standalone_statement_draft:

The restriction functors $j^{-1}$ (abelian sheaves) and $j^*$ (ringed-module sheaves) are exact. For a ringed site $(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ and cartesian square of objects, the slice sites inherit ring sheaves $\mathcal O_X$ etc. The isomorphism concerns the ordinary exact restriction $j^*$ on **module derived categories**, not the inverse-image $j^{-1}$ used for abelian sheaves.
